Noah Rivera: Hey folks 1 I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows 07:00 (I'm UTC+7) and there's no Zoom join URL in the event. Did I get the AMER series by mistake? :thinking_face:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Noah! We run multiple recurrences for different regions. If the Zoom link is missing you were likely added to the AMER series. Recordings are uploaded to Confluence after the session. Organizer: Tariq Al-Masri.
Tariq Al-Masri: Sorry about that @Noah 1 looks like a calendar mapping error. APAC slot is "New Hire Welcome (APAC/EU)" at 09:30 SGT. Quick join: https://zoom.us/j/5556667777
Tariq Al-Masri: Passcode: Welcome2026 (case sensitive). We'll publish slides + recording (with transcript) within 24 hours. Sessions are ~75 mins including Q&A and account setup.
Noah Rivera: Thanks 1 if I miss it, where will the recording live and for how long?
Maya (People Ops): Recordings + transcripts go to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings and are retained 90 days by default. Need permanent access? DM people-ops or email people-ops@redwood.com and we can archive.
Zoe Chen: Accessibility note 1 can live captions be enabled? Who do we tell?
Maya (People Ops): Good question. We can enable live captions and other accommodations if requested 48+ hours before the session. DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com with the request and any details.
Noah Rivera: Outlook is showing the event time in UTC and not converting to my local zone. Any fast fixes?
Tariq Al-Masri: Outlook can be funky with subscribed series. Options: 1) Export the single-event ICS (Event -> More actions -> Export) and import it into your calendar instead of subscribing; 2) Check File -> Options -> Calendar -> Time zones; 3) Accept the event and view details (client should convert). If that doesn't work DM me and Ill send a corrected one-off ICS.
Onboarding Bot: Organizer updated event metadata: region=APAC, corrected recurrence and added Zoom link. Attendees re-notified. :white_check_mark:
Noah Rivera: Imported the ICS into my calendar and it's showing correct local time now 1 thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
Tariq Al-Masri: Welcome aboard @Noah 1 ping me here if you need account access sorted before the session. We'll drop the recording link in this thread after the call."
